title: Public C retained backup KEK scan input, pending D persistence alignment
description: Data returned by an authenticated complete-scan source. This JSON never establishes completeness, transaction isolation, authority or permission to retire a key.
x-runtime-validation: All four partitions are mandatory; source_id/revisions are opaque values supplied by D's original source, not invented timestamps or row maxima.

A trusted source authenticates full enumeration/EOF and a fence covering concurrent append, unknown write, hold, restore/prune and retirement. A caller-provided count/hash or complete=true cannot prove this.

Missing source, nil scan, omitted partition, expiry, pagination gap or changed fence rejects retirement. A non-nil empty list is acceptable only after every original source has proven empty under the shared fence.
Unknown writes and reservations retain the planned exact key before a final envelope exists. Unresolved binding is unavailable, never skipped.
references are unique and sorted by UTF-16 order of JCS([partition,source_record_id,source_record_version,envelope_id]); references_sha256 is SHA256(UTF8(JCS(references))).
Each partition count/hash covers its filtered references array using the same order. binding_sha256 is SHA256(UTF8(JCS(key_binding))).

binding_sha256 alone is insufficient for recovery. mapping_source retains the original full immutable mapping and its CA source; expected_request_source retains the original full KeyRequest from the existing plan/envelope source, including its complete context. Authenticate and verify referenced bytes before use. Never reconstruct expectedRequest solely from untrusted wrapped data or copy an old grant as current recovery authority.
Do not exclude references solely on task terminal state, expired timestamp or deleted SQL flag. D must supply authoritative lifecycle and absence/cleanup facts.

The original bootstrap/config-mutation transaction must recheck source_revision, all snapshot/fence revisions and the proposed map before commit. No network IO or independent commit in locked Recheck.
